# v0.7 specialist quality experiment register

**Prepared task cases:** evals/v07-quality-benchmarks.json (6 fixed scenarios, 5 weighted criteria each, total 12 points per case).

**Recorded runs:** evals/v07-run-manifest.json with 12 independent sessions and SHA-256 of every raw model response. All 12 Codex text-only model runs completed, with task prompts generated by scripts/prepare_v07.py. The probe run is not part of the six-pair scored comparison.

## What is actually proven

- Six independent A/B comparisons were **executed**, saving raw text.
- Identical fictional task text and the same model family/configuration were used per pair, with the skill text prepended to the candidate input.
- The output bytes match the registered hashes. Code Mode host and tool execution were unavailable (reasoning-only task).
- 43 tests across six offline domain fixtures passed in a local environment; they check authored reference code, not the model's actual code generation.

## What is not yet proven

- No blind/independent reviewer has graded rubric coverage, correctness, hallucination or maintainability. Each case remains **COMPLETED_UNSCORED**.
- No repeated trials or statistical uncertainty interval has been established.
- No native Agent Skills trigger routing, ChatGPT Project retrieval success rate, MCP protocol end-to-end test, actual package-vulnerability feed scan or production load/restore has been executed.
- The earlier subjective mean around 6.9/10 cannot be automatically upgraded to 8.5 from these data.

## Recommended scoring pass

Have at least two independent reviewers score anonymized A/B raw outputs against the 5 case criteria, requiring line-level evidence and flagging unsupported factual assertions. Resolve disagreements, then run multiple additional trials with varied prompts and at least one actual non-sensitive code-change exercise per skill. Publish score distributions and model/tool version details rather than only mean improvements.
